evidence: Atomic layer deposition is an effective method for uniform deposition of low-amount OER/ORR catalyst materials on conductive matrix. Inspired by this and above, herein, we design and realize a new integrated cathode, denoted as GF-CNT@MoS2, where amorphous MoS2 is deposited on CNT substrates growing on a 3D graphite foam (GF) current collector, through a pressure-tuned stop-flow atomic layer deposition (ALD) process.
